problem:

When was the last birthday Grandma had?

(L. Hozová)

Hint. How many whole years are 50 months?

answer_text:
Looking at this problem, I need to convert all of Grandma's age components into a consistent unit to find her total age in complete years and remaining days.

## Converting Each Component

**Step 1: Convert 50 months to years** (as the hint suggests)

$$50 \text{ months} = 4 \text{ years} + 2 \text{ months}$$

**Step 2: Convert 40 weeks to days**

$$40 \text{ weeks} = 40 \times 7 = 280 \text{ days}$$

**Step 3: Combine all the "extra" beyond 60 years**

$$2 \text{ months} + 280 \text{ days} + 30 \text{ days} = 60 \text{ days} + 280 \text{ days} + 30 \text{ days} = 370 \text{ days}$$

## Finding Total Age in Complete Years

Using the standard conversion **1 year = 12 months = 360 days**:

$$370 \text{ days} = 1 \text{ year and } 10 \text{ days} \quad (370 = 360 + 10)$$

So Grandma's total age is:

$$\underbrace{60}_{\text{years}} + \underbrace{4}_{\text{from 50 months}} + \underbrace{1}_{\text{from 370 days}} = 65 \text{ years and } 10 \text{ days}$$

## Verifying

$$65 \text{ yr} + 10 \text{ d} = 65\times360 + 10 = 23\,400 + 10 = 23\,410 \text{ days}$$

$$60\times360 + 50\times30 + 40\times7 + 30 = 21\,600 + 1\,500 + 280 + 30 = 23\,410 \text{ days} \;\checkmark$$

## Conclusion

Grandma is **65 years and 10 days** old, meaning her last birthday (when she turned 65) was **10 days ago**.

$$\boxed{10 \text{ days ago}}$$
